span.p: Governance - Change-approval ladder

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
TIER 1: CONTENT
e.g. practice hours, parking info, phrasing tweak
Approver: single named content owner (no engineering)
Turnaround: hours
Gate: none - direct edit

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
TIER 2: CONVERSATIONAL FLOW
e.g. new trigger phrase, reordering a script step
Approver: Product/CX owner + eval suite pass
Turnaround: ~24 hours
Gate: success-evaluation criteria must pass

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
TIER 3: GUARDRAIL / SAFETY SCRIPT
e.g. emergency escalation wording, consent preamble, refusal language
Approver: Clinical Safety Officer + InfoSec sign-off + full eval run
Turnaround: weekly release window (expedited path for urgent safety fixes)
Gate: full simulated-conversation test suite + adversarial/red-team pass

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
TIER 4: NEW TOOL / WRITE ACTION
e.g. new capability touching R4 / Dataphiles / HubSpot
Approver: threat model + security review + architecture sign-off
Turnaround: planned release only, not ad hoc
Gate: threat model documented + security review + staged rollout
